data.name: Avnish
data.gender_notes: Avnish is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Avni means 'desirable' and Sh means 'pure'. This name represents the purity of desire and the wish for a pure and desirable life. The name Avnish carries the meaning “Desirable, Pure” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Avnish usually hope their child will grow to embody desirable, pure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Avnish belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Desirable, Pure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Avnish total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
